blocks.x: Trial eligibility matching at 10x — enrollment windows met
A European biopharma group — Healthcare & Life Sciences engagement delivered by a 19-person team over 15 months, EU scope, commercial model: build-transfer.

items: Eligibility matching ran on chart review; two trials missed enrollment windows at a cost of years.
RWE pipelines rebuilt per study; regulatory-grade provenance missing.
Discovery screening compute-bound on HPC with unclear quantum relevance.

blocks.x: We built the eligibility engine: protocol criteria translated to governed EHR queries with evidence bundles for each candidate, plus a Quanta pilot benchmarking screening formulations against classical baselines (verdict: parity at current scale — documented). RWE pipelines moved to reusable, provenance-complete templates.

The program ran through the Achala Method: a Value Mapping Sprint locked the baseline, a gated PoC produced the capital-grade evidence, and production hardening (replay, SLOs, control tests) was generated by the delivery itself rather than reconstructed for audit.

items: Yield +3.4 points and energy per tonne down 17% — APC augmentation program
Yield +2.8 points, recalls scoped in minutes — quality and traceability program
